corrections_vs_repo_config_VEHICLE_META.note: config.VEHICLE_META in this repo had multiple mismatches vs the official paper. This JSON uses the paper. Missing fields are null / 'not available' (never filled with DEFAULT_META_FALLBACK).

purpose: Dense synthetic coverage at every integer speed in each vehicle supported range.

generation_notes.matching_rule: One synthetic clip for every integer speed in each inclusive vehicle speed range.
generation_notes.speed_range_source: Per-vehicle min/max from vs13_manifest.json; KiaSportage lower bound explicitly set to 30 km/h per request.
generation_notes.pass_by_timing_rule: cpa_sec is independently sampled from Uniform(4.5, 5.5) seconds for every clip.
generation_notes.output_layout_hint: Write synthetic WAVs as <out_root>/<vehicle_dir>/<stem>.wav and mirror TXT labels as '<speed_kmh> <cpa_sec>' to match VS13.
generation_notes.conditioning: Model uses speed_kmh, cpa_sec, engine, transmission, power_kw, year, body_class plus physics signals derived from speed/CPA.
